objective: Resolve the remaining scientific-validation mismatch by measuring CPVS light-curve quality-flag semantics against the published 730,184-object selection without weakening the fail-closed gate.

baseline.description: CPVS parent evidence validates at 781,602 rows, but deterministic g/r threshold derivation produced 741,785 instead of the published 730,184 subset.

evidence: Live Scientific Validation execution identified a reproducible 11,601-object excess in the derived subset.
New diagnostics report source quality-flag distributions and candidate counts without relaxing the expected-count gate.
validation.blocker: The correct CPVS quality-flag interpretation remains to be verified by the next source-backed execution.

root_causes: Magnitude-error threshold alone is insufficient to reproduce the published 730,184-object subset from the supplied CPVS light curves.
The supplementary light curves expose band-specific quality flags that must be measured against the published selection.

findings: The parent catalog is correctly resolved at 781,602 objects.
The remaining mismatch is in light-curve quality selection, not parent-ID parsing or archive discovery.

open_blockers: Next Scientific Validation run must identify and implement the source-backed quality selection that reproduces 730,184 exactly.
